name: smwmusic-trials-of-mana-ancient-dolphin-arrangement
title: Trials of Mana - Ancient Dolphin (arrangement)
description:
A quiet, haunting song that plays in a final dungeon. Useful for finals, temples and night levels.

Trivia:
- My favourite dungeon in the game.
- I spent 30% of production time trying to fix one mistake in the midi file.
- Big thanks to user @Brozilla for teaching me $FA$02$XX some months ago because I abused it to save memory space. Also it made the code organizing a cakewalk! :))
- Again big thanks to user @musicalman for his sample pack.
- After @Tamaki's suggestion, I made the instrumentation closer to the original's. I still do not own the original samples (@Samantha), so I'll leave it as "remix" and try to get started in sample ripping.
- Update 27/05: fixed the notes at the end and the bell octave at the beginning.
